# pokus-preflight command

`pokus-preflight` detects the host and decides whether the lab is supported on it (see [Support matrix](../../support-matrix.md) and [Host profile schema](../host-profile.md)).

```text
pokus-preflight [-h] [--root PATH] [--output FILE] [--offline]
                       [--srv-path PATH] [--accept-degraded]
                       [--accept-experimental] [--force-unsupported]
                       [--adopt-incus] [--allow-dirty] [--no-write]
                       [--color {auto,always,never}] [--quiet]
                       [--repo-commit SHA] [--matrix FILE] [--endpoints FILE]
                       [--version]
```

Detect the host, decide whether the Pokus lab is supported on it, and print a JSON host profile. Read-only except for storing the profile on real runs as root.

## Options

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h`, `--help` | — | — | show the help and exit |
| `--root` | `PATH` | — | inspect a fixture root instead of this host; commands come from PATH/commands.json |
| `--output` | `FILE` | — | write the JSON report to FILE instead of stdout |
| `--offline` | — | — | skip network reachability checks (for testing only) |
| `--srv-path` | `PATH` | `/srv/pokus` | configured location of the research space (default: /srv/pokus) |
| `--accept-degraded` | — | — | record consent to continue with missing optional features |
| `--accept-experimental` | — | — | record consent to continue on an experimental tier |
| `--force-unsupported` | — | — | record that the operator forces an unsupported host (carried into every fingerprint) |
| `--adopt-incus` | — | — | treat an existing, unmanaged Incus installation as a warning instead of a blocking conflict |
| `--allow-dirty` | — | — | record that bootstrap runs from an infra/ tree with uncommitted changes |
| `--no-write` | — | — | never store the profile in /etc/pokus or /var/lib/pokus |
| `--color` | `auto`, `always`, `never` | `auto` | color the summary (auto: only on a terminal and without NO_COLOR) |
| `--quiet` | — | — | do not print the summary |
| `--repo-commit` | `SHA` | — | commit to record as repo_commit (default: detected with git) |
| `--matrix` | `FILE` | `/home/user/pokus/infra/preflight/support-matrix.json` | compiled support matrix (JSON) |
| `--endpoints` | `FILE` | `/home/user/pokus/infra/preflight/endpoints.json` | compiled endpoint list (JSON) |
| `--version` | — | — | show program's version number and exit |

Exit codes: 0 supported, 10 degraded, 20 unsupported, 30 needs_action, 40 preflight_error. See [Exit codes](../exit-codes.md).
